Official geography label. Canada national tables are labelled Canada. Ecozone, boreal and managed-forest tables use the official row label, including a Canada total row when the official table has one.

estimate for a stock or area in that cycle, or annual_change for the official annual change reports.

Official class label, when a class column is present.
Official column header of the cell, such as an age class, ownership class, or Forest land.
Official published figure, copied as text from the source CSV. Official placeholders None and hyphen are stored blank.
Official relative standard error in percent, when an official SE file exists for that table. Blank when no official SE file was published or the official cell was a placeholder.

Official confidence interval half-width in the same unit as value, when an official CI file exists. This is the amount published in the NFI CI table, not a separately computed bound. Blank when no official CI file was published.
Relative path of the official estimate CSV under the NFI summaries tree.
Relative path of the official relative standard error CSV, when present.
